path.description: CSV file path relative to the workspace root, for example data/orders.csv. Absolute paths, '..' and links that leave the root are refused.

rows.description: How many rows to return when group_by is not given.

seed.description: Seed of the random choice. The same file, seed and arguments give the same rows.

group_by.description: Column name. When given, return up to per_group rows for each distinct value of it.

per_group.description: Rows for each value of group_by.

max_groups.description: Refuse when group_by has more distinct values than this.

columns.description: Return only these columns. The group_by column is always returned.

delimiter.description: Field separator. auto picks the one that gives the most rows of equal width.

encoding.description: Text encoding. utf-8 also accepts a byte order mark.

has_header.description: true when the first row holds column names. When false, columns are named column_1, column_2 and so on.

max_cell_chars.description: Longer cell values and group values are cut to this many characters. Cut cells are listed in shortened_cells; a cut group value carries its full length in chars.
